config.textarea: Paste a JSON configuration for the simulation or array for batch runs

jitter.toggle: Enable jitter for switch timing and fill pressure

config.batch: Interpret config as array and run all entries

slider.voltage: Adjust the driving voltage applied to the plasma sheath.
slider.pressure: Set the background gas pressure used in the simulation.

tutorial.root: Step through a quick configuration example.
tutorial.apply: Apply example voltage and pressure settings
